protocol.comparison: DFlash2 B in {3,5,7} batched chain verify vs same-session AR (13.4 tok/s) and exact native MTP B3 (23.85 tok/s, 1.7845x AR)
protocol.note: Root-cause fix: --block-size was previously force-clamped to drafter config block_size 8, so every claimed B run verified the full 8-row chain. The cycle now forwards at config block size but truncates the verify chain to block_size-1 drafts.

blocker: Not promoted: the best operating point B3 (7.704 tok/s = 0.575x AR pre-Q6-select, 8.845 = 0.66x after) is ~3.1x below exact MTP B3 (23.85 tok/s = 1.78x AR). B3 is the optimum *against the current verify*: measured verify is ~166 ms at 4 rows and ~620 ms at 8 rows because the amortized resident-pack8 rowtile is not admitted above 4 rows (_PACK8_ROWTILE_MAX_ROWS = 4), so the 8-row verify re-reads the full weights once per row (~8.0 weight sweeps at the 221 GB/s practical roof). With an amortized deep verify the optimum would move to a deeper chain, so this sweep does not establish that shallow chains are right for DFlash2 on this hardware. Acceptance is at parity with MTP (2.80 vs 2.85 tokens/cycle at B3); the deficit is drafter+verify cost. See 'correction' below.

correction.what_changed: loss attribution only; no measured value in this artifact changed
correction.misread: MTP B3 'acceptance 3.85 / 0.96 per row' was read from 2026-08-17-gfx1151-qwen38-27b-q4ks-exact-native-b3.json as accepted tokens per cycle. 3.85 is target_forward_rows/cycles (335/87) = verify ROWS per cycle. MTP B3's accepted tokens per cycle is (161+87)/87 = 2.85, and its per-verify-row acceptance is 0.740.

corrected_comparison.note: acceptance is at parity (~2%); the deficit is drafter+verify cost

withdrawn_claims: MTP B3 sustains ~0.96 accepted tokens per verify row / sits near the B3 cap
the 4->8 row verify cost growth is O(N^2) causal block attention
the 166ms verify is shared with MTP and not DFlash2-specific
no operating point on this lane can reach MTP B3 regardless of drafter cost
correction.protocol_mismatch: the MTP B3 comparator row is Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_S.gguf at --max-new-tokens 25 via qwen36_dense_gguf_suite.py with reusable target graphs; these DFlash2 rows are Q4_K_M at 40 tokens via dflash2_gguf_suite_smoke.py with per-cycle Python and explicit syncs, and the timed verify additionally carries DFlash2-only 5-layer hidden-state capture. Ratios-to-AR are comparable; absolute rates are not same-lane.
correction.hardware_field_fixed: gpu was 'AMD Radeon Pro W7900-compute-lane (gfx1151 resident)', which names the wrong machine (W7900 is gfx1100). Actual host: strixhalo, AMD Radeon 8060S Graphics, gfx1151.
correction.reproducibility_note: as of 2026-08-22 the drafter snapshot, ~/dflash, Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_S.gguf and ~/sm120-tuning are all absent from this host; re-running requires re-fetching the drafter and the Q4_K_S comparator target.
